title: Create an Odoo customer
intent: Create exactly one customer from a user-supplied name and email, after checking duplicates and receiving explicit confirmation.
instructions: Use query_customers when useful to inspect current delegated-user facts before proposing a write.
Call create_customer with the exact customer name and email address supplied by the user.
The server will normalize the proposal, check duplicates over a complete scan, show the exact effect for confirmation, execute at most once, and read it back under the same user.
After a successful result, open only the returned ui_path and observe the page before finishing.
If confirmation is denied or a write outcome is uncertain, stop; never retry the mutation.
